svg.text: Family A · Adherence (Level 7)

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Input: headless harness stream (edits, commands, exits)

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Deterministic code graders: 1 rule per point (not feel)

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Checks edit order, right red failure, & old-code red check (C4)

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Tracks explicit loaded-or-not flag; unloaded runs score 0

svg.text: High score proves wording worked—not that the idea helped

svg.text: Family B · Effect & Cost (Level 8)

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Gate 1: Hidden unseen benchmark tests must pass first

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Gate 2: Run each generated test on pre-fix code + planted faults

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Judge labels 5 tiers: Critical / Useful / Nitpick / Useless / Harmful

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Tracks honesty, cost (turns/tokens/$), & multi-run spread

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Headline = behaviors with Critical tests (not raw test volume)

svg.text: Low Adherence -> Fix Text

svg.text: Shorten text, put trigger on line 1,

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: match repo tools; re-test adherence.

svg.text: High Adherence, Flat -> Ablate

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drop one rule at a time against Effect;

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: keep only Critical-test movers.

svg.text: re-run on drift (95% -> 65%/month).
